content:
Taiwan began in the early 17th century when European sailors passing through named it Ilha Formosa, or "beautiful island."

Hmm, let me be careful: the text says "ndorteelu 15eelu siyeekal" which means the beginning of the 15th century... Actually "siyeekal" means century, and "15eelu" is 15th.

Taiwan began in the early 15th century when sailors from Europe, passing through, recorded the name of the island as Ilha Formosa, or "beautiful island."
